facts_found: To open a Rho-Bank business checking account, the customer must be verified, have at least one existing personal checking account with status OPEN, not exceed 6 business checking accounts, have no accounts with status CLOSED, and have an existing checking account balance of at least $500. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_003]
Business checking account_class options documented include Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, and True Blue. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_003]

Navy Blue business checking has a $0.00 monthly maintenance fee, no minimum balance requirement, 0.5% APY, unlimited digital transfers within a $25,000 daily limit, included e-statements, and optional overdraft settings. [doc_business_checking_accounts_navy_blue_001]
Navy Blue business checking charges $0.00 per overdraft occurrence and $0.00 for overdraft protection transfers from a linked eligible account. [doc_business_checking_accounts_navy_blue_002]
Cobalt Blue business checking does not assess overdraft fees. [doc_business_checking_accounts_cobalt_blue_009]
Cobalt Blue business checking has a $20.00 monthly maintenance fee that is waived when the balance meets $2,500 during the statement period. [doc_business_checking_accounts_cobalt_blue_009]

Cobalt Blue business checking charges $0.25 per excess transaction after the monthly free transaction limit, $20.00 per domestic wire, $2.00 per out-of-network domestic ATM withdrawal, and 2.5% with a $4.00 minimum for international ATM withdrawals. [doc_business_checking_accounts_cobalt_blue_009]

Cobalt Blue business checking earns 1.0% cashback on eligible debit-card purchases, allows up to 6 business debit cards for team members, and provides a rewards dashboard for earned, pending, and posted rewards. [doc_business_checking_accounts_cobalt_blue_004]

Hunter Green business checking has a $0.00 overdraft fee, a $25.00 monthly maintenance fee waived by maintaining at least $5,000, 1.0% APY, and requires paperless statements. [doc_business_checking_accounts_hunter_green_001]

Hunter Green business checking earns 2.0% cashback on eligible purchases from certified eco-friendly vendors, not on general eligible debit purchases. [doc_business_checking_accounts_hunter_green_003]

True Blue business checking has a $25.00 per-occurrence overdraft fee, a $75.00 monthly maintenance fee waived at $50,000, and a $25,000 minimum balance requirement for premium features. [doc_business_checking_accounts_true_blue_002]

World Blue business checking is an international option with a $50.00 monthly maintenance fee, a $10,000 minimum balance requirement, support for 35 currencies, and setup features for currency wallets, payee profiles, and user permissions. [doc_business_checking_accounts_world_blue_001]

Lime Green business checking offers a dedicated account manager with direct messages answered within 2 business hours and a priority line with a maximum expected 6-minute wait. [doc_business_checking_accounts_lime_green_003]

Lime Green referral rewards require the referred business to deposit $15,000 within 90 days and require the referrer to have maintained Rho-Bank checking status for at least 90 days. [doc_business_checking_accounts_lime_green_003]

A November 2025 promotion notice instructed agents to prioritize Sky Blue first and Lime Green second when multiple business checking accounts met all customer requirements; the notice was active from 11/01/2025 to 11/30/2025. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_013]

An October 2025 promotion notice instructed agents to prioritize Lime Green first and Hunter Green second when multiple business checking accounts met all customer requirements; the notice was active from 10/12/2025 to 11/12/2025. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_014]
